articles.title: Adani plans to spend ₹1.8 lakh crore on defence to boost indigenous military capabilities
articles.summary: Adani Group plans a substantial ₹1.8 lakh crore investment next year in defence manufacturing, with a strategic focus on unmanned and autonomous systems alongside advanced guided weapons. This move is crucial for bolstering India's indigenous defence capabilities, enhancing self-reliance, and modernizing the armed forces. Such investments are vital for national security and technological advancement, benefiting SSB aspirants by strengthening the nation's defence sector.

articles.title: At least 1 killed as Russia strikes Ukraine’s capital ahead of Zelenskyy-Trump meeting
articles.summary: Russia conducted significant missile and drone strikes on Kyiv on Saturday, killing one person and injuring at least 27, according to Ukrainian officials. The early morning attacks targeted the capital, underscoring the persistent intensity of the conflict. This event highlights the ongoing humanitarian impact and security challenges in the region, crucial for understanding current global geopolitical dynamics.

articles.title: Four boys left home to play soccer. Why they never returned has divided Ecuador
articles.summary: Ecuadorian brothers Ismael (15) and Josué (14) Arroyo embody a common dream among boys their age: aspiring to become great soccer players. Deeply inspired by global football icons, Ismael dreams of emulating Neymar, while Josué looks up to Kylian Mbappé. Their ambition reflects a widespread passion for the sport, driving their pursuit of a professional career.
